details.label: Summary
details.text: A localized severe threat may continue into the early overnight hours

details.label: Discussion
details.text: A persistent storm cluster is moving south-southeastward across central IL late this evening. While this cluster has struggled to maintain severe intensity, MLCAPE of near/above 2000 J/kg and relatively enlarged low-level hodographs (with effective SRH of 150-200 m2/s2) may continue to support modest storm organization and transient rotation into the early overnight hours. This could support potential for localized wind damage for as long as this cluster remains vigorous, though a gradual weakening trend is eventually expected with time
